positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked closely with PM team as well as other software engineers to develop new features and debug existing features of the LoanSnap web and mobile app using ReactJS and React-Native

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
-Worked on a team coding the Parlinet web app using NodeJS with Express framework and MongoDB
-Designed and implemented features of the Parlinet web app such as a filter and search through results and a simple relevance algorithm.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Studied collective motion in E. Coli.
-Annotated genes.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
-Accompanied a scientist in researching digestive enzymes to isolate one particular enzyme that allows for the most release in protein.
-Utilized ELIZA reader to analyze the protein concentration in control and variable groups
-Data analysis and designed experiments

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Conducted research to identify the effects of palmitic methyl ester (PAME) on the migration rate of mesenchymal stem cells under the supervision of Professor Kun Da Yang of Tzu Chi University.
